readme: Automated follower log. The Thursday routine (Sandcastles) appends one entry per account per run. Entries with verified=true are merged into the app's follower chart via the seed; verified=false entries are kept for the record but never shown (protects the chart from stale/mis-scraped values). Manual entries in the app always win (merge by id).
